intro.title: The Magic Forest
intro.text: You enter a mystical forest where coding powers the world. A wise owl appears: 'This forest is losing its magic! Learn the ancient art of coding to restore it.'

village.title: Village of Variables
village.text: Villagers carry labeled boxes. Luna explains: 'These are VARIABLES - containers for information. I store my name in this box!' She shows a box labeled 'name' with 'Luna' inside.

concept.name: Variables
concept.explanation: Variables are like labeled boxes that store information.

choices.text: Create a variable for your name
Just remember it without a box

variable_success.title: Variable Mastery!
variable_success.text: Perfect! The villagers cheer as the fountain glows with magic! You understand that variables help organize information.

variable_lesson.title: A Gentle Lesson
variable_lesson.text: The owl hoots: 'Computers need variables to track information. Without them, everything is lost!' The villagers help you create your first variable.

bridge.title: Bridge of Conditions
bridge.text: A sphinx guards the bridge: 'Understand IF-THEN statements to pass!' The bridge has two paths: sunny IF daytime, ELSE moonlit. It's currently night.

concept.name: Conditionals
concept.explanation: Make decisions based on true/false conditions.

conditional_success.title: Wise Choice!
conditional_success.text: The sphinx smiles: 'You understand conditions check true/false and act accordingly. Since it's night, you chose ELSE wisely!' The bridge glows.

conditional_lesson.title: Learning from Mistakes
conditional_lesson.text: Locked! The sphinx explains: 'IF daytime is FALSE, so we use ELSE. Conditions are yes/no questions that guide decisions.'

river.title: Repeating River
river.text: A frog shows 5 stepping stones: 'Use a LOOP to step on each stone instead of writing step five times!'

choices.text: Use a loop for all 5 stones

loop_success.title: Loop Master!
loop_success.text: The frog applauds: 'Perfect! One loop for all stones. Imagine 100 stones - loops save time!' The river sparkles with magic.

loop_lesson.title: A Better Way
loop_lesson.text: It works but it's exhausting! The owl: 'Use loops to repeat actions. Much faster and easier to change!'

falls.title: Function Falls
falls.text: A wizard shows magic spell stones: 'These are FUNCTIONS - reusable spells! Name them once, use many times!' He calls FireSpell() and flames appear.

concept.name: Functions
concept.explanation: Named code blocks you can reuse.

function_success.title: Forest Restored!
function_success.text: Your restoreForest() function brings the forest back to life! The wizard: 'Functions organize code into reusable pieces!'

function_lesson.title: Working Smarter
function_lesson.text: Hours pass fixing each piece. The wizard: 'Use a function! Group steps together and call restoreForest() once!'

finale.title: Grand Oak's Wisdom
finale.text: The ancient oak awakens: 'You've learned the four pillars: VARIABLES store, CONDITIONALS decide, LOOPS repeat, FUNCTIONS organize. With these, create anything!'

complete.title: Quest Complete!
complete.text: Congratulations! You've mastered coding fundamentals through your forest adventure. The magic is restored!
